_instructions: Reference only — this file is never loaded by the catalog. The easiest way to add a book is `node tools/add-book.mjs`, which asks these same questions interactively. If you'd rather prepare a draft by hand and run `node tools/add-book.mjs --from your-draft.json`, copy this file, fill it in, delete every key starting with an underscore, and add two extra (tool-only) keys: `_coverPath` and `_ebookPaths` (an array) pointing at files on your computer — the tool copies them into place and strips those keys before saving the record.
_slug: (required) Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens. Permanent — never change it once it's live. Must match this file's name.
_roles: (required, at least one) Allowed: written-by, compiled-by, archived-by, edited-by, researched-by, transcribed-by, subject, original-author. Never credit someone with writing what they didn't write.
_description: (required) The public summary a visitor reads before buying.
_formats: (required, at least one) Allowed: pdf, epub, mobi, other.
_price: Display only, e.g. "$14" — not charged by anything here.
_state: One of: public, portfolio-preview, private, forthcoming, active-research, archived, hidden-draft. Validation refuses "public" without a live purchase link.
_purchase: kind: "none" until the product is live on your store, then "external" with href = the product's https:// URL. Update later with: node tools/add-book.mjs --set-purchase-link <slug> <url> [label]
